_comment: Which of mxm-mono-02's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
This map claims amp_env.trigger, the role added to the standard with this instrument:
the role and the instrument entered the standard in one change, so no player compiles in
one without the other and withholding it would protect nobody - docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md
section 9 records the rule and its reason.
The machine's hard-wired modulation is routing now: every depth role names the amount of a
route the init patch wires, so its knob is live on a fresh instance. The pulse width is shared
by both oscillators, so the Osc 2 page's width slot names the same parameter as the Osc 1
page's. osc1.tune is the master tune; osc2.tune is VCO-2's own.
osc1.pwm_source and osc2.pwm_source are unfilled: the source switch is gone, its two positions
being two routes. osc1.pwm_depth and osc2.pwm_depth are unfilled: the init patch routes nothing
to the pulse width (the owner, 2026-09-27), so a depth knob there would be dead.
filter_env.polarity is unfilled: the envelope's polarity is the sign of its route's amount.
mod_pitch_lfo is also reachable on CC 77 as the fixed vibrato-depth knob.
